title: Boundary wall overshadowing within C3.9.1
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.9.1; and

replaces.note: overshadowing reference now C3.9.1 only; C3.9.2 and C3.9.3 not cited

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Cross-reference only: the test is C3.9.1 (element 3.9, another part). Recorded as judgment so the element is complete; the overshadowing result for the lot is read from C3.9.1. The draft omits C3.9.2 and C3.9.3 though they now govern narrow-lot and single-storey cases (register ch2-066).
